Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereMultipartiteEntanglementSpectrum`

```text
FQHESphereMultipartiteEntanglementSpectrum, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereMultipartiteEntanglementSpectrum [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --density-matrix : file containing the reduced density matrix
    --na : number of particles in the A part (default value = 0)
    --nb : number of particles in the B part (default value = 0)
    -l, --nbr-orbitals : number of orbitals in the A part (default value = 0)
    -s, --sz-value : twice the Sz value of A part (SU(2) mode only) (default value = 0)
    --su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2) spin (override autodetection from the reduced density matrix file name)
    -o, --output : output name for the entanglement spectrum (default name replace density-matrix full.ent extension with la_x_na_y.entspec)
    -e, --eigenvalue-error : lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eignvalue (default value = 1e-14)
    --show-minmaxlza : show minimum an maximum Lz value that can be reached
    --show-counting : show degeneracy counting for each Lz value
    --particle-entanglement : compute particle entanglement spectrum

misc options:

global options:
```
